# JSONPlaceholder API Test Scenarios

## Generated by: Chat AI (Claude)
## Date: feb 13th 2026
## Target API: https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com

### Positive Test Cases
1. GET All Posts - Verify 100 posts returned with valid schema
2. GET Single Post - Verify individual post retrieval
3. GET Posts by User - Verify filtering functionality
4. CREATE New Post - Verify POST operation
5. UPDATE Post (PUT) - Verify full update
6. PARTIAL UPDATE (PATCH) - Verify partial update
7. DELETE Post - Verify deletion

### Negative Test Cases
8. GET Non-existent Post - Verify 404 handling
9. POST Missing Fields - Verify validation
10. POST Invalid Data Types - Verify type checking
11. Unsupported HTTP Method - Verify 405 response

### Edge Cases
12. Boundary ID Values - Verify edge case handling
13. Special Characters - Verify encoding/escaping
14. Invalid Query Params - Verify param validation
15. Large Payload - Verify size limits

**Total Scenarios: 15**

## 🎯 Problem Statement

Manual API test case creation in QA is slow, repetitive, and error-prone. Writing comprehensive test coverage for a single REST API typically takes **4–6 hours** and often misses negative and edge cases.

This project solves that by chaining two AI tools together to generate a complete, working test suite in **under 45 minutes**.

---

## 🔗 Workflow Overview

```
Chat AI (Claude)  →  IDE AI (GitHub Copilot Chat)  →  Working Test Suite
```

| Stage | AI Type | Tool | Input | Output |
|-------|---------|------|-------|--------|
| 1 | Chat AI | Claude (claude.ai) | JSONPlaceholder API description | `test-scenarios.md` (15 test scenarios) |
| 2 | IDE AI | GitHub Copilot Chat (VS Code) | `test-scenarios.md` + Maven project | `BaseTest.java`, `Post.java`, `PostsAPITest.java` |
| 3 | CLI / Build | Apache Maven | Generated `.java` files | Test execution results |

---

## 🛠️ Tech Stack

- **Language:** Java 11
- **Build Tool:** Apache Maven
- **Test Framework:** REST Assured 5.3.2 + JUnit 5.10.0
- **Target API:** [JSONPlaceholder](https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com)
- **AI Tools:** Claude (Chat AI) + GitHub Copilot Chat (IDE AI)

---

## 📁 Project Structure

```
api-test-suite-generator/
├── pom.xml
└── src/
    └── test/
        └── java/
            └── com/qa/capstone/
                ├── config/
                │   └── BaseTest.java        # REST Assured base configuration
                ├── models/
                │   └── Post.java            # POJO for API response
                ├── tests/
                │   └── PostsAPITest.java    # 15 automated test cases
                └── utils/                   # Helper utilities
```

## 🚀 Running the Tests

```bash
# Clone the repository
git clone <your-repo-url>
cd api-test-suite-generator

# Run all tests
mvn clean test
```
